symptoms: typical: Feathery or mottled patterns on leaves, light to dark purple or green severe_strains: Leaf chlorosis Leaf distortion Necrotic spots co-infections: SPVD: When co-infected with SPCSV, causes stunting, mosaic leaves, reduced yield
management: early_detection: Monitor leaf symptoms and confirm via ELISA removal: Rogue infected plants to prevent spread prevention: Plant virus-free propagation material Maintain vector (aphid) control Hygienic pruning and tool sanitation
sources: Based on SPFMV research and sweet potato viral disease studies
